properties.name: ai.execution.output-finalization.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum bounded structured-generation attempts after parse or validation failure. Provider call failures are not retried and no deterministic fallback is produced.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.enabled
properties.description: Load versioned specialist manifests, schemas, and prompt profiles during application startup.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.fail-fast
properties.description: Fail application startup when a specialist resource cannot be loaded, validated, compiled, or merged.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.locations
properties.description: Classpath or mounted resource patterns containing immutable specialist YAML or JSON documents.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.max-manifest-bytes
properties.description: Maximum canonical byte size of one Specialist manifest document.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.max-resource-bytes
properties.description: Maximum byte size of one configured specialist resource file.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.enabled
properties.description: Enable the opt-in bounded multi-specialist chain runtime.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-active
properties.description: Maximum non-terminal chain executions retained by this application instance.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-duration
properties.description: Deployment ceiling for one bounded chain deadline.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-manager-decisions
properties.description: Deployment ceiling for manager decisions in one chain, including final completion.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-worker-invocations
properties.description: Deployment ceiling for read-only worker invocations in one chain.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-parallel-workers
properties.description: Deployment ceiling for one ALL_REQUIRED parallel worker group.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-invocations-per-target
properties.description: Per-target invocation ceiling. The first release requires exactly one.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-projected-result-characters
properties.description: Maximum approved projected worker-result characters exposed to later manager decisions.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-directive-corrections
properties.description: Maximum bounded runtime-feedback retries for a manager directive that selects an exhausted target or supplies incorrect final result attribution.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.durable-enabled
properties.description: Use a durable SpecialistChainExecutionRepository. The provided production adapter requires Spring JDBC and a DataSource.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.allow-ephemeral
properties.description: Explicitly acknowledge process-local chain state for tests or read-only experiments.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.initialize-schema
properties.description: Create the JDBC chain table at startup. Intended for tests and self-contained demos; production applications should own migrations.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.lease-duration
properties.description: Lease duration for one claimed chain continuation.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.recovery-interval
properties.description: Interval between abandoned-chain and retention scans.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.recovery-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum chain records considered in one recovery or cleanup scan.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum durable continuation claims before a chain fails visibly.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.cleanup-enabled
properties.description: Delete terminal chain records after the configured retention period.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.retention
properties.description: Retention period for terminal durable chain records when cleanup is enabled.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.encryption-secret
properties.description: Stable secret used to encrypt durable request, checkpoint, and result state. Must contain at least 32 characters.

properties.name: ai.execution.specialist-chains.fingerprint-secret
properties.description: Stable distinct secret used for keyed chain access, idempotency, and request fingerprints. Must contain at least 32 characters.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.enabled
properties.description: Enable durable, separately authorized human review around governed action proposal receipts.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.repository
properties.description: Review task and dispatch receipt repository. JDBC is required for durable cross-process review.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.initialize-schema
properties.description: Create review JDBC tables at startup. Intended for tests and self-contained demos; production applications should own migrations.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.decision-lease-duration
properties.description: Lease duration for one claimed review decision continuation.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.recovery-interval
properties.description: Interval between expired-task, abandoned-decision, and retention recovery scans.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.recovery-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum review tasks processed by one recovery scan.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.max-dispatch-attempts
properties.description: Maximum idempotent dispatcher delivery attempts retained for one waiting review task.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.max-decision-attempts
properties.description: Maximum durable continuation claims before a review decision fails visibly.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.cleanup-enabled
properties.description: Delete terminal review tasks after the configured retention period.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.retention
properties.description: Retention period for terminal review tasks when cleanup is enabled.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.encryption-secret
properties.description: Stable secret used to encrypt protected review source, decision, and result state. Must be at least 32 characters and distinct from receipt secrets.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.fingerprint-secret
properties.description: Stable secret used for keyed reviewer, tenant, source, and idempotency fingerprints. Must be at least 32 characters and distinct from receipt secrets.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.allow-in-production
properties.description: Explicitly acknowledge non-durable IN_MEMORY review state under a prod or production profile.
